t: This is Hampstead War Memorial, a tall, thin stone obelisk on a square plinth with a three-step base. It stands in front of Heath House, opposite Jack Straw's Castle, where North End Way, Heath Street and Spaniards Road meet on the northern edge of the Heath. It remembers local people who died in the First and Second World Wars. It was dedicated on the fourth of May, 1922, by the Bishop of Willesden. The architect was Sir Reginald Blomfield, a prolific designer and garden designer of the Victorian and Edwardian period.
